changes.description: Warning when Kiro CLI runs as root or Administrator, with a global `app.warnOnElevatedPrivileges` setting to disable it
`/fullscreen` pins the prompt you are reading to the top row; click it to jump back to the prompt
Original Kiro ghost greets you on startup and stays visible in the conversation
A refused response on Auto is now retried so another model can answer instead of ending the turn
[V3] MCP servers and web tools now follow your organization's settings
Model fallback no longer hangs when a refused response contains a tool call
Dictation commands like "scratch that" and other bursts of Backspace now delete text in the chat prompt and search fields
[V3] Resuming a V2 session no longer warns that agent `default` was not found or drops the planner
[V3] On Linux, resuming a session after a reboot no longer reports it as open in another terminal
`/chat` and `--resume` no longer time out when listing a large session history
[V3] `/mcp` now explains which configured servers your organization's MCP registry hid
[V3] `kiro-cli mcp list` no longer shows a skipped registry server as active
[V3] HTTP MCP servers that answer the protocol probe with HTTP 403 now connect instead of failing
[V3] A refusal with no output right after a tool result now ends the turn instead of looping
[V3] `read_file` with an offset past the end of a file no longer reports the file as missing
Kiro CLI now offers to switch you to V3 when you start a chat
